svg.title: Mapping of six tongue locations to six actuator channels on a forearm sleeve
svg.desc: The anterior-to-posterior axis of the tongue is mapped onto the wrist-to-elbow axis of a 30 cm sleeve. Six tongue locations correspond one-to-one with six actuator channels; the lateral margins channel uses two motors on opposite sides of the forearm.
svg.text: Positions are measured from motor 1. Motor 1 sits 1.5 cm from the wrist edge, so sleeve positions
